card.name: Linking words after dosing or exposure phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, during, from, on, of) right after a dosing or animal-exposure phrase, such as 'taken orally', 'pregnant rats', or 'once daily'. Seen in drug-label dosage and reproductive toxicity text.

modes.label: Food instructions
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'taken' or 'orally', leading into 'with or without food'.
modes.example: MEKTOVI may be taken<< with>> or without food [see Clinical Pharmacology

modes.label: Pregnant animal dosing
modes.description: A time-linking word after 'pregnant' animals were given a drug, before a gestation period.
modes.example: oral administration of erdafitinib to pregnant rats<< during>> the period of organogenesis caused malform

card.plain: It marks the small joining word that comes after a dosing or pregnant-animal exposure phrase and introduces the timing or food condition.
